purpose: Provide safe discovery of published property-law answers by topic, legal issue, event, date and public-safe general area without treating search similarity as property identity, evidence or legal correctness.
core_principle: SEARCH → CANDIDATES → SCOPE CHECK → ACCESS CHECK → OPEN APPROVED CONTENT
rules: A matching name or address is not proof of property identity.
A search result is not proof of ownership, title, registration or legal effect.
Current and historical answers remain distinct.
Private investigations are never exposed through public search.
Search ordering does not imply correctness, quality or legal preference.
Only approved public snapshots are searchable in the public archive.
Search snippets do not replace the approved answer or its official sources.
Personal and sensitive information is excluded from public indexing unless demonstrably necessary and public-safe.
hard_stops: Never use search similarity as property identity.
Never present search ranking as legal ranking.
Never use a search result as property-specific evidence before source validation.
Never convert a historical answer into a current answer.
Never infer a legal conclusion from keywords alone.
